concretechanges.before: This is not a metaphor. It is a measurement. Rupert Sheldrake called it morphic resonance
concretechanges.after: This supplied observation does not establish a non-local effect; improved technique and shared knowledge would also need to be considered. Rupert Sheldrake proposed morphic resonance

concretechanges.before: When the Large Hadron Collider smashes protons, it is not merely testing physics. It is reinforcing the habits of subatomic particles, deepening the groove of their behavior until the groove looks like a prison wall.
concretechanges.after: Taken as an imaginative proposition, nature’s habit asks how repetition and apparent fixity relate. It does not establish that accelerator experiments reinforce particle behaviour.

concretechanges.before: they proved that anatomy is a field phenomenon first and a molecular phenomenon second.
concretechanges.after: the work gives bioelectric state a consequential role in development. It does not, by itself, verify morphic resonance or rank fields above molecules.

concretechanges.before: This is the mechanism behind the hundredth-monkey effect — not telepathy, but topology.
concretechanges.after: The hundredth-monkey story cannot establish this mechanism; a topology metaphor is not evidence of collective non-local learning.

concretechanges.before: Extinction events are not random catastrophes. They are the collapse of fields that have grown too rigid to adapt, too laden with the cost of their own repetition to respond to new conditions.
concretechanges.after: The rigid rut is an image for difficulty adapting. Extinction events require their own geological and ecological explanations.

concretechanges.before: This is structurally identical to morphic resonance:
concretechanges.after: I place this beside morphic resonance as a speculative comparison:

concretechanges.before: The machine learned the habits of proteins the way proteins learn the habits of their fields.
concretechanges.after: The comparison is suggestive, but a model learning from structural data does not demonstrate that proteins learn from a morphic field.

concretechanges.before: Gravity warps space-time. In the context of morphic resonance, this warping is the cost function of the network — the drag that governs how information propagates across the substrate. Consciousness is not an emergent property of complex systems. It is the fundamental medium in which the network operates.
concretechanges.after: In the cosmology explored here, I imagine consciousness as the medium of a network and gravitational curvature as one image of its accumulated constraints. This is authored speculation; it supplies no physical cost function or established account of consciousness.

concretechanges.before: The work is not to escape the groove but to recognize it as a groove — to suspend the paradigm long enough to see that the eternal laws are just the longest-running habits, and that even they began as experiments.
concretechanges.after: The Hanged Man offers a posture for holding the question open. A groove can be examined without assuming that every law is a habit, or that an unfamiliar explanation has already escaped its own rut.
